svg.text: * shutdown only when one disk reads ≥ 58 °C three times in a row and a second disk reads ≥ 50 °C.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An isolated hot disk gets full air and a critical alert, never a shutdown. Both thresholds belong to the guard, not to the curves.
